composition.currentLayout: ExploreScreen composes Scaffold, SafeArea, browse chrome, filter rail, CustomScrollView slivers, membership mutation listener, mixed event/person/organizer feed, empty/error states, and floating map count pill; route provider-wave branch precedence, empty-state derivation, and map count label route through ExploreDiscoveryScreenState, which delegates body loading/error/content/empty branches to ExploreScreenBodyState and map label derivation to ExploreMapLauncherState. Browse/search-open chrome labels and search expansion policy route through ExploreChromeState, city-trigger chrome labels/icons route through ExploreCityButtonState, filter active-count/sheet-option copy routes through ExploreFilterRailState and ExploreFilterSheetState, cover-story copy routes through ExploreCoverStoryState, and mixed-feed card ordering plus event/external/person/organizer row labels route through ExploreFeedSectionState, ExploreEventRowState, ExploreExternalEventRowState, CrossPathsExploreCard, and ExploreOrganizerCardState. Cross Paths is optional fail-closed enrichment and never replaces its associated event ticket. ExploreMapScreen is a child route that reuses the event map view model; the retired map peek-rail summary/ticket adapters are no longer part of the active composition.
composition.targetLayout: ExploreScreen should map provider state into an ExploreDiscoveryScreenState and compose registered sections: browse chrome, scope/filter rail, cover story, day ticket feed, club interleaves, cross-paths card, event type browse grid, map launcher, empty/error states, and map route sheet/overlay.

sections.name: Mixed discovery feed
sections.currentOwner: ExploreBody, ExploreEventsSection, ExploreFeedSectionState, ExploreCoverStoryState, ExploreEventRowState, ExploreExternalEventRowState, CrossPathsExploreCard, and ExploreOrganizerCardState
sections.migration: ExploreFeedSectionState owns mixed feed card selection, result-count copy, Cross Paths person insertion, organizer intermix ranking, and This Week promotion. ExploreCoverStoryState owns the ranked cover-story identity and availability-aware CTA copy with an injected clock for tests. Explore event tickets reuse the consent-safe veiled attendee stack, ExploreOrganizerCardState owns organizer context, and CrossPathsExploreCard composes catch.person_polaroid with separate associated-event context and actions from a server-owned sanitized suggestion. DateTicket/EventTicket roles map to catch.event_card; organizer spotlights map to catch.organizer_poster through OrganizerCard. The old standalone CrossPathsCard proposal remains retired.

sections.migration: ExploreCoverStoryState now owns activity-independent cover copy and test-time clock behavior. CoverStory is promoted through the catch.cover_story component contract, with route-owned CTA/search callbacks staying outside the reusable visual contract.

sections.name: Map launcher

sections.name: Explore map route
sections.migration: The dropped Explore map peek-rail lead and selected-pin ticket widgets were retired in the event/club/profile parity handoff. ExploreMapScreen now owns selected-pin route state and renders the selected event through the canonical EventDateRailCard overlay; EventPinsMap renders DS activity map pins for deterministic placeholders and byte-backed native markers. Widgetbook covers ready, selected-card, loading, empty, no-exact-pin, error, and distance-ring route states. Remaining work: map dynamic-region masking, keeping EventMap as the map primitive, and moving route chrome/provider-wave data into an adapter.

ExploreScreen uses provider-free ExploreScreenBodyState for route loading/error/content/empty branch precedence and ExploreDiscoveryEmptyState for source-club/search/filter empty copy and clear-action cardinality. ExploreEventsSection uses provider-free ExploreEventsEmptyState for feed-empty copy, clear-search/filter intent, and broaden-time-filter intent. Remaining work is only product policy: decide whether feed-only failures should stay inline or promote to the screen-level error contract.
